generator.amount_rendering: customer center minor=100*localization_factor*exp(global_log_amount_center+relative_log_amount_center), constrained >=1; per-event lognormal draw has the inherited event-schema minimum of 1 minor

same_day_repeat_atom.projection: retain sampled end day and set first day equal to last day
same_day_repeat_atom.selection: select exactly round(q*repeat_count) repeat positions by ascending SHA256(seed:entity-fidelity-v6-same-day-atom:position), ties by position

generator.canonical_allocator: singleton minimum 1, repeat minimum 2, extras by sampled-count residual; target exact and strata immutable
generator.cell_allocation: floor(m*p) plus residual resampling from normalized fractional residuals

hour_allocation.render: seeded shuffle across sessions; sort hours within day; duplicate-hour positive truncated-lognormal gaps rescaled within 3600 seconds
hour_allocation.repeat_integerization: largest remainder, deterministic improving one-event exchanges, then deterministic improving two-event exchanges; lexicographic ties
hour_allocation.repeat_probability: for convex-hull interior targets p_h is proportional to empirical w_h*exp(lambda_s*sin(theta_h)+lambda_c*cos(theta_h)); projected boundary targets use the deterministic exact edge mixture or vertex delta of the limiting exponential family
hour_allocation.repeat_repair_termination: squared-error descent exceeding a 32-ulp numerical guard over a finite integer state space with visited-state cycle assertions
hour_allocation.session_boundaries: same-day repeats use one session; multiday sessions are merged to feasible capacity and separated by more than 24 hours; adjacent-day equal boundary hours jointly partition integer seconds 0..3599
hour_allocation.singleton: joint 3x3x24 category; rendered hour equals sampled category

generator.repeat_invoice_count_allocation: exact residual allocation from fixed calibration PMF on integer support 0..256, rank-reordered by inherited invoice_count then index

same_day_repeat_atom.probability: P(first_day=last_day | invoice_count>=2), fitted on each profile/fold
same_day_repeat_atom.projection: retain sampled end day and set first day equal to last day
same_day_repeat_atom.selection: select exactly round(q*repeat_count) repeat positions by ascending SHA256(seed:entity-fidelity-v6-same-day-atom:position), ties by position

generator.sampling: singleton continuous U=(bin+V)/3 plus exact hour category; repeat U=(bin+V)/3, linear 32-knot inverse except inverted-CDF/right-step discrete invoice count
generator.tie_rule: I=[count(x'<x)/n,count(x'<=x)/n]; cell mass is the mean product of fractional overlaps with thirds

time_coordinates.window: integer UTC days with midnight bounds [first_day,last_day+1); no clipping

one_shot_final.split_assignment: first 64 SHA-256 bits of 20260827:uci502-v4-readiness-v1:<customer_id>; <2^63 transform-only, otherwise score
one_shot_final.transform_half_use: amount ECDF and fixed-window transform only
